IMPORTANT MEMO - RAW MINERAL EXAMINATIONS

Hey guys,

Corporate's stressing about the quality of the ore samples we sent back last week. I guess the client thinks that the stuff we're extracting isn't pure enough for their project. I want to get ahead of this, so I'm going to start personally checking the quality of every haul. When you're done for the day, I need you to let me know so I can come check out what you found. I'll get rid of anything that's missing the mark, so we all look good for the bosses. 

Thanks,

Supervisor Beal

items.source_en:
These guys think I'm crazy, they say I've been out here too long. But I'm not crazy. I'm smart... real smart. "Come have a drink with us Russo" they said, but while everyone is getting drunk and punching each other in the face I'm out here... watching, waiting, thinking. And I think I've got it figured out.

You see, it all started back when we were sent our first batch of supplies. That's the first time we saw them. There was only like a handful of those creatures, and it's our job to take these things on. So, whatever. No big deal.

After that, no more attacks, not a peep. The next resupply ship comes in and there they are, out of no where. Again, no problem, we take them out. The thing is, this keeps happening every time we get restocked, and there's a couple more of those things each time.

The guys don't care. They keep saying they're bored, it's the only time they get to shoot stuff, and it must be the food that attracts them. I keep telling them they never go for the crates! They're attracted to the sound of those damn ships! I'm telling you right now, if we don't take care of these things, we're screwed.
items.legacy_ko:
대원들이 나더러 미쳤다고 한다. 내가 여기 너무 오래 있어서 그런다나. 난 미친 게 아니다. 난 똑똑이라고... 진짜 똑똑이. '와서 한 잔 하지, 루소' 그러는데, 다들 취해서 서로 얼굴에 주먹질할 때 나는 여기 나와 있다... 와서 바라보고, 기다리고, 생각한다. 그리고 알아낸 것 같다.

그러니까, 우리가 첫 보급품을 받았을 때 시작된 거 같다. 그때 처음 놈들을 봤다. 처음엔 한 줌도 안 되는 숫자였고, 놈들을 맡는 게 우리 일이었다. 그러니 뭐, 큰 문제는 아니었다.

그 뒤로, 공격은 없었다. 낌새도 안 보였다. 다음 재보급 함선이 왔는데, 놈들이 갑자기 튀어나왔다. 다시 한 번, 아무 문제 없이, 우리가 놈들을 해치웠다. 문제는, 우리가 보급품을 보충받을 때마다 이게 계속 반복되는데, 매번 놈들의 수가 조금씩 늘었다는 점이다.

대원들은 신경도 안 쓴다. 맨날 그때만 총질을 할 수 있으니 따분하다고, 놈들이 음식에 이끌리는 거라고만 한다. 난 놈들이 한 번도 화물을 노리지 않았다고 계속 얘기했는데! 저놈들은 저 망할 함선 소리 때문에 뛰쳐나오는 거라고! 분명히 말하는데, 이놈들을 제대로 처리하지 않으면, 우린 조진 거다.

items.source_en: I'm not a doctor, but Captain Volpe has instructed me to do my best to understand the condition that has befallen some members of our crew. Wesley and Matt seem to be in unbearable pain, yet they can barely express it as paralysis seems to be setting in across their bodies. Gina is trying to comfort them, as I look for any record of any sickness like this.
